test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 9 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the bracketed word to fill in the blank.

All the__________ (delicate) things were kept/packed in a different box while shifting to a new place.
solution:
The correct answer is fragile.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate synonym of the given word 'delicate' is 'fragile'.
 
• Delicate: easy to damage or break
 
• Meaning of the given options:
 
 
• crude*: *simple and basic, without much detail, skill, etc.
 
• durable: likely to last for a long time without breaking or getting weaker
 
• coarse: consisting of large pieces; rough, not smoot
 
• *fragile: easily damaged or broken*
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 4.​

 

Correct sentence: *All the **fragile** (delicate) things were kept/packed in a different box while shifting to a new place.*
